program: NSF Scholarships in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics Program (S-STEM)

requirements.text: Grants are subject to NSF award terms and conditions.
requirements.source_quote: All NSF grants and cooperative agreements are subject to the applicable set of NSF [award terms and conditions](/awards/terms-conditions "Award Terms and Conditions").
requirements.source_heading: Important information for proposers and award recipients

requirements.text: Proposers must comply with updated NSF research security policies.
requirements.source_quote: NSF has updated its [research security policies](/notices/important/important-notice-no-149-updates-nsf-research-security/in149 "Important Notice No. 149: Updates to NSF Research Security Policies") for NSF funded projects.
requirements.source_heading: Important information for proposers and award recipients

requirements.text: Full proposals must be submitted by 5 p.m. at the submitting organization's local time.
requirements.source_quote: (due by 5 p.m. submitting organization's local time)

requirements.text: The full proposal deadline is March 04, 2025.
requirements.source_quote: March 04, 2025

requirements.text: Subsequent annual deadlines occur on the first Tuesday in March each year.
requirements.source_quote: First Tuesday in March, Annually Thereafter

requirements.text: Institutions submitting a Track 1 proposal may not have had an active STEP or S-STEM award in the past 5 years.
requirements.source_quote: Institutions submitting a Track 1 proposal may not have had an active Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics Talent Expansion Program (STEP) or S-STEM award in the past 5 years.

requirements.text: Track 1 proposals must include an initial planning/capacity building period during which scholarships are not made to students.
requirements.source_quote: Track 1 proposals must include an initial planning/capacity building period during which scholarships are not made to students.

requirements.text: Scholarships for Track 1 proposals should be awarded only after the conclusion of the planning/capacity building period.
requirements.source_quote: Scholarships should be awarded to students after the conclusion of the planning/capacity building period.

requirements.text: For Track 1 proposals, at least 50% of all funds must be provided solely as pure scholarships and entered as Participant Support – Stipends (Line F1).
requirements.source_quote: For Track 1 proposals, at least 50% of all funds must be provided solely as pure scholarships to cover the cost of attendance and entered as Participant Support – Stipends (Line F1) on the NSF budget form.

requirements.text: A one-page analysis of job prospects should not be included as a Supplementary Document.
requirements.source_quote: A one-page analysis of job prospects is no longer required and should not be included as a Supplementary Document.

requirements.text: For six-year proposals, Current and Pending (Other) Support should be reported for the first five years of the project.
requirements.source_quote: For proposals with a duration of six years, Current and Pending (Other) Support should be reported for the first five years of the project.

requirements.text: Proposals requesting a six-year duration must be submitted via Research.gov.
requirements.source_quote: proposals requesting a six-year duration must be submitted via Research.gov because Grants.gov will not accommodate a six-year budget.

requirements.text: Proposers are responsible for ensuring the proposal meets the requirements of the NSF PAPPG in effect for the relevant due date.
requirements.source_quote: it is the responsibility of the proposer to ensure that the proposal meets the requirements specified in this solicitation and the applicable version of the PAPPG.

requirements.text: Scholars must be domestic low-income students with demonstrated unmet financial need.
requirements.source_quote: To be eligible, scholars must be domestic low-income students with academic ability, talent, or potential and demonstrated unmet financial need

requirements.text: Scholars must have academic ability, talent, or potential.
requirements.source_quote: To be eligible, scholars must be domestic low-income students with academic ability, talent, or potential and demonstrated unmet financial need

requirements.text: Scholars must be enrolled in an S-STEM eligible discipline at an associate, baccalaureate, or graduate degree program.
requirements.source_quote: who are enrolled in an associate, baccalaureate, or graduate degree program in an S-STEM eligible discipline.

requirements.text: Proposals must provide an analysis articulating the characteristics and academic needs of the target student population.
requirements.source_quote: Proposers must provide an analysis that articulates the characteristics and academic needs of the population of students they are trying to serve.

requirements.text: For degrees in fields not explicitly listed as critical needs, proposers must make a compelling case that the field serves a critical need in the United States.
requirements.source_quote: It is up to the proposer to make a compelling case that such a field serves a critical need in the United States.

requirements.text: Proposals must adapt, implement, and study evidence-based curricular and co-curricular activities for recruitment, retention, student success, and graduation.
requirements.source_quote: the program provides awards to institutions of higher education (IHEs) not only to fund scholarships, but also to adapt, implement, and study evidence-based curricular and co-curricular[[a](#refa)] activities that have been shown to be effective in supporting recruitment, retention, transfer (if appropriate), student success, academic/career pathways, and graduation in STEM.

requirements.text: Clinical degree programs such as medical, nursing, veterinary medicine, pharmacy, and physical therapy are excluded.
requirements.source_quote: Clinical degree programs, including medical degrees, nursing, veterinary medicine, pharmacy, physical therapy, and others not funded by NSF, are ineligible degrees.

requirements.text: Programs for STEM teacher certification or licensure covered by the Robert Noyce Teacher Scholarship program are excluded.
requirements.source_quote: Programs for STEM teacher certification or licensure currently covered by the Robert Noyce Teacher Scholarship program (NOYCE) are ineligible for S-STEM funding.

requirements.text: Bachelor of Arts or Science in Business Administration degrees are excluded.
requirements.source_quote: Business school programs that lead to Bachelor of Arts or Science in Business Administration degrees (BABA/BSBA/BBA) are not eligible for S-STEM funding.

requirements.text: Masters and Doctoral degrees in Business Administration are excluded.
requirements.source_quote: Masters and Doctoral degrees in Business Administration are also excluded.

requirements.text: Track 1 projects cannot exceed a total funding amount of $2,000,000.
requirements.source_quote: Awards for Track 1 (Institutional Capacity Building) projects may not exceed $2,000,000 total

requirements.text: Track 1 projects have a maximum duration of 6 years.
requirements.source_quote: for a maximum duration of 6 years.

requirements.text: If funding is provided to an international branch campus, the proposer must explain the benefit(s) to the project and justify why activities cannot be performed at the US campus.
requirements.source_quote: Special Instructions for International Branch Campuses of US IHEs: If the proposal includes funding to be provided to an international branch campus of a US institution of higher education (including through use of sub-awards and consultant arrangements), the proposer must explain the benefit(s) to the project of performance at the international branch campus, and justify why the project activities cannot be performed at the US campus.

requirements.text: For Track 1 and Track 2 proposals, the Principal Investigator must be a faculty member currently teaching in an S-STEM eligible discipline or an academic administrator who has taught in one of the eligible disciplines.
requirements.source_quote: For Track 1 and Track 2 proposals, the Principal Investigator must be (a) a faculty member currently teaching in an S-STEM eligible discipline, or (b) an academic administrator who has taught in one of the eligible disciplines

requirements.text: The Principal Investigator must be able to dedicate the time necessary to assure project success.
requirements.source_quote: and can dedicate the time necessary to assure project success.

requirements.text: A single Principal Investigator must accept overall management and leadership responsibility for projects involving more than one department.
requirements.source_quote: Projects involving more than one department within an institution are eligible, but a single Principal Investigator must accept overall management and leadership responsibility.

requirements.text: Faculty from all departments involved must have roles in the project as either Co-Principal Investigators, other senior/key personnel, or scholar mentors.
requirements.source_quote: Faculty from all departments involved must have roles in the project as either Co-Principal Investigators, other senior/key personnel, or scholar mentors.

requirements.text: For Track 3 projects, the Principal Investigator must be a faculty member currently teaching in an S-STEM eligible discipline, an academic administrator who has taught one, or a researcher investigating questions related to low-income student success.
requirements.source_quote: For Track 3 (Inter-institutional Consortia) projects, the Principal Investigator must be (a) a faculty member currently teaching in an S-STEM eligible discipline, (b) an academic administrator who has taught an S-STEM eligible discipline, or (c) a non-teaching institutional, educational, or social science researcher investigating questions related to low-income student success.

requirements.text: The Principal Investigator must be able to provide the leadership and time required to ensure the success of the project.
requirements.source_quote: The Principal Investigator must be able to provide the leadership and time required to ensure the success of the project.

requirements.text: Track 3 consortium proposals must have a Principal Investigator who accepts overall management and leadership responsibility across all consortia members.
requirements.source_quote: Track 3 consortium proposals must have a Principal Investigator who accepts overall management and leadership responsibility across all consortia members.

requirements.text: For a given S-STEM deadline, an institution may submit up to two proposals in which it will be directly involved in providing scholarships.
requirements.source_quote: For a given S-STEM deadline, an institution may submit up to two proposals in which it will be directly involved in providing scholarships.

requirements.text: Multiple proposals from an institution must not overlap with regard to S-STEM eligible disciplines.
requirements.source_quote: Multiple proposals from an institution must not overlap with regard to S-STEM eligible disciplines.

requirements.text: Institutions with a current S-STEM award should wait at least until the end of the third year of execution of their current award before submitting a new Track 2 or Track 3 S-STEM proposal focused on students pursuing degrees in the same discipline(s).
requirements.source_quote: Institutions with a current S-STEM award should wait at least until the end of the third year of execution of their current award before submitting a new Track 2 or Track 3 S-STEM proposal focused on students pursuing degrees in the same discipline(s).

requirements.text: Full proposals submitted via Research.gov must follow NSF Proposal and Award Policies and Procedures Guide (PAPPG) guidelines.
requirements.source_quote: Full Proposals submitted via Research.gov: *NSF Proposal and Award Policies and Procedures Guide* (PAPPG) guidelines apply.

requirements.text: Full proposals submitted via Grants.gov must follow the NSF Grants.gov Application Guide guidelines.
requirements.source_quote: Full Proposals submitted via Grants.gov: *NSF Grants.gov Application Guide: A Guide for the Preparation and Submission of NSF Applications via Grants.gov* guidelines apply

requirements.text: Voluntary committed cost sharing is prohibited.
requirements.source_quote: Inclusion of voluntary committed cost sharing is prohibited.

requirements.text: Other budgetary limitations apply and are detailed in the full text of the solicitation.
requirements.source_quote: Other budgetary limitations apply. Please see the full text of this solicitation for further information.

requirements.text: Full proposals are due annually on the first Tuesday in March thereafter.
requirements.source_quote: First Tuesday in March, Annually Thereafter

requirements.text: The proposal must adhere to the National Science Board approved criteria.
requirements.source_quote: National Science Board approved criteria.

requirements.text: Additional merit review criteria apply beyond the NSB standard, and proposers should consult the full solicitation for details.
requirements.source_quote: Additional merit review criteria apply. Please see the full text of this solicitation for further information.

requirements.text: Institutions with any active STEP or S-STEM award in the past 5 years are ineligible for Track 1.
requirements.source_quote: The entire institution is ineligible if any program, department, or school within the institution has had an active STEP or S-STEM award in the past 5 years.

requirements.text: Track 1 proposals may request up to $2,000,000 total for up to 6 years.
requirements.source_quote: Track 1 proposals may request up to $2,000,000 total for up to 6 years.

requirements.text: At least 50% of all Track 1 funds must be pure scholarships entered as Participant Support – Stipends (Line F1).
requirements.source_quote: In Track 1 proposals, at least 50% of all funds must be provided solely as pure scholarships to cover the cost of attendance and entered as Participant Support – Stipends (Line F1) on the NSF budget form.

requirements.text: Track 1 PI must be a faculty member currently teaching in an eligible discipline or an academic administrator who has taught in one and can dedicate necessary time.
requirements.source_quote: Track 1 projects must be led by a PI who is (a) a faculty member currently teaching in one of the S-STEM eligible disciplines being pursued by the targeted scholars, or (b) an academic administrator who has taught in one of the eligible disciplines and can dedicate the time necessary to assure project success.

requirements.text: Track 1 leadership team must include a STEM administrator at the level of department head or above.
requirements.source_quote: The leadership and management team should also include a STEM administrator at the level of department head or above.

requirements.text: Track 1 proposals must detail an initial planning/self-study period lasting between 6 and 12 months.
requirements.source_quote: This planning period should last between 6 and 12 months

requirements.text: Track 3 leadership teams must be composed of faculty currently teaching in eligible disciplines, STEM administrators, and/or non-teaching researchers.
requirements.source_quote: Track 3 projects are managed by leadership and management teams composed of faculty members who are currently teaching in an S-STEM eligible discipline(s), STEM administrators, and non-teaching institutional, educational, or social science researchers.

requirements.text: Track 3 PI must be a faculty member currently teaching in an eligible discipline, a STEM administrator (dept head+), or a non-teaching researcher with specific expertise.
requirements.source_quote: The PI of Track 3 proposals must be either (a) a faculty member currently teaching in one of the S-STEM eligible disciplines, (b) a STEM administrator (department head or above), or (c) a non-teaching researcher whose expertise is in institutional, educational, or social science research in higher education.

requirements.text: Track 3 projects are subject to a formal review during their third year with continued funding contingent on the result.
requirements.source_quote: Track 3 projects will be formally reviewed by NSF during their third year to determine whether satisfactory progress has been made, with continued funding contingent on the result of the third-year review.

requirements.text: For conference proposals, proposers must consult with an S-STEM program officer.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals for conferences addressing important needs within the S-STEM community may be submitted at any time following consultation with an S-STEM program officer.

requirements.text: Scholarship recipients must meet the institutional definition of low-income status and be enrolled in degree programs listed in the proposal.
requirements.source_quote: All students meeting the institutional definition of low-income status and enrolled in degree programs listed in the proposal should receive fair consideration for S-STEM funding

requirements.text: Projects must build their work on needs analyses specific to the targeted population of low-income students in the proposed disciplines.
requirements.source_quote: All projects must build their project on needs analyses specific to the targeted population of low-income students in the proposed disciplines.

requirements.text: IHEs must develop, support, and maintain S-STEM scholar cohorts.
requirements.source_quote: To this end, IHEs are expected to develop, support, and maintain S-STEM scholar cohorts

requirements.text: Track 1 proposals must submit a supplemental document of no more than 4 pages describing the initial planning period.
requirements.source_quote: This planning period should last between 6 and 12 months and should be described in a supplemental document of no more than 4 pages.

requirements.text: The Track 1 planning supplement must include defined activities, a clear timeline, and designated roles for project leadership team members.
requirements.source_quote: This document should include defined activities, a clear timeline, and designated roles for members of the project leadership team in the planning process.

requirements.text: Each institution awarding scholarships must submit a letter from their Office of Financial Aid certifying understanding of 'last dollar' requirements.
requirements.source_quote: Each institution that will award scholarships must submit a letter from their respective Office of Financial Aid certifying the Office's understanding of the guidelines and requirements of the S-STEM program

requirements.text: The Office of Financial Aid letter must provide the institutional definition of low income, affirm scholars will meet it, and commit to supporting the project.
requirements.source_quote: This letter must provide the institutional definition of low income, affirm that scholars will meet its definition of low income, and commit to supporting the project as described in the proposal if awarded.

requirements.text: The maximum individual scholarship amount is $15,000 per year for undergraduate students.
requirements.source_quote: The established maximum amount of an individual scholarship is $15,000 per year for undergraduate students

requirements.text: Scholarships must cover the scholar's actual unmet need or the maximum allowable scholarship amount, whichever is less.
requirements.source_quote: Scholarships must cover the scholars' actual unmet need or the maximum allowable scholarship amount, whatever is less.

requirements.text: The prospective scholar pool analysis must provide the number of students meeting low-income and nominal academic talent criteria.
requirements.source_quote: 1. The number of students meeting both the institutional definition of low-income and any nominal criteria meant to estimate academic talent (e.g., GPA); and

requirements.text: The prospective scholar pool analysis must provide the average unmet need of these students as calculated by the Financial Aid office.
requirements.source_quote: 2. The average unmet need of these same students, as calculated by the institutional Financial Aid office.

requirements.text: Track 1 and Track 2 proposals do not require an additional research component, only a strong evaluation plan.
requirements.source_quote: Track 1 and Track 2 proposals require a strong evaluation plan, but do not require an additional research component.

requirements.text: Track 3 proposals must include both a strong evaluation plan and a strong research component.
requirements.source_quote: In contrast, Track 3 (Inter-institutional Consortia) proposals must include both a strong evaluation plan and a strong research component.

requirements.text: S-STEM projects are required to participate in regular NSF-led data collection activities to follow student progress.
requirements.source_quote: S-STEM projects (Track 1, 2 and 3) are required to participate in regular NSF-led data collection activities to follow student progress as specified in section VII.C of Reporting Requirements.

requirements.text: Total funding for Track 1 (Institutional Capacity Building) projects cannot exceed $2,000,000.
requirements.source_quote: Awards to support Track 1 (Institutional Capacity Building) projects may not exceed $2,000,000 total

requirements.text: The maximum project duration for Track 1 is 6 years.
requirements.source_quote: over a maximum duration of 6 years.

requirements.text: Total funding for Track 2 (Implementation Projects) cannot exceed $2,000,000.
requirements.source_quote: Awards for Track 2 (Implementation Projects) projects may not exceed $2,000,000 total

requirements.text: Total funding for Track 3 (Inter-institutional Consortia) cannot exceed $5,000,000.
requirements.source_quote: Awards for Track 3 (Inter-institutional Consortia) projects may not exceed $5,000,000 total

requirements.text: The requested funding level must be based on the actual number of low-income students in the targeted disciplines.
requirements.source_quote: The level of funding requested should be based on the actual number of low-income students in the disciplines targeted.

requirements.text: Proposals may only be submitted by institutions of higher education that are accredited in the U.S., have a campus located in the U.S., and act on behalf of their faculty members.
requirements.source_quote: Institutions of Higher Education (IHEs): Two- and four-year IHEs (including community colleges) accredited in, and having a campus located in the U.S., acting on behalf of their faculty members.

requirements.text: If funding is provided to an international branch campus, the proposer must explain the benefits and justify why activities cannot be performed at the US campus.
requirements.source_quote: the proposer must explain the benefit(s) to the project of performance at the international branch campus, and justify why the project activities cannot be performed at the US campus.

requirements.text: For Track 1 and Track 2 proposals, the Principal Investigator must be a faculty member currently teaching in an S-STEM eligible discipline.
requirements.source_quote: For Track 1 and Track 2 proposals, the Principal Investigator must be (a) a faculty member currently teaching in an S-STEM eligible discipline

requirements.text: For Track 1 and Track 2 proposals, the Principal Investigator may alternatively be an academic administrator who has taught in an eligible discipline and can dedicate necessary time.
requirements.source_quote: or (b) an academic administrator who has taught in one of the eligible disciplines and can dedicate the time necessary to assure project success.

requirements.text: A single Principal Investigator must accept overall management and leadership responsibility for projects involving more than one department.
requirements.source_quote: Projects involving more than one department within an institution are eligible, but a single Principal Investigator must accept overall management and leadership responsibility.

requirements.text: Faculty from all departments involved must have roles as Co-Principal Investigators, other senior/key personnel, or scholar mentors.
requirements.source_quote: Faculty from all departments involved must have roles in the project as either Co-Principal Investigators, other senior/key personnel, or scholar mentors.

requirements.text: For Track 3 proposals, the Principal Investigator may alternatively be an academic administrator who has taught an S-STEM eligible discipline.
requirements.source_quote: (b) an academic administrator who has taught an S-STEM eligible discipline

requirements.text: For Track 3 proposals, the Principal Investigator may alternatively be a non-teaching researcher investigating questions related to low-income student success.
requirements.source_quote: or (c) a non-teaching institutional, educational, or social science researcher investigating questions related to low-income student success.

requirements.text: Track 3 consortium proposals must have a Principal Investigator who accepts overall management and leadership responsibility across all consortia members.
requirements.source_quote: Track 3 consortium proposals must have a Principal Investigator who accepts overall management and leadership responsibility across all consortia members.

requirements.text: Multiple proposals from an institution must not overlap with regard to S-STEM eligible disciplines.
requirements.source_quote: Multiple proposals from an institution must not overlap with regard to S-STEM eligible disciplines.

requirements.text: An institution part of a larger system is considered separate for proposal submission if it is geographically separate and has its own chief academic officer.
requirements.source_quote: An institution that is part of a larger system is considered separate for proposal submission purposes if it is geographically separate from the other campus(es) and has its own chief academic officer.

requirements.text: The address of the place of performance on the NSF cover sheet should be different for geographically separate institutions.
requirements.source_quote: The address of the place of performance on the NSF cover sheet should be different as well.

requirements.text: Institutions with current active S-STEM awards should not submit a new proposal focusing on the same student population until after the third year of execution has been completed and the annual report approved.
requirements.source_quote: Institutions with current active S-STEM awards should not submit a new proposal focusing on the same student population until after the third year of execution has been completed and the corresponding annual report approved.

requirements.text: Only institutions without active S-STEM or STEP funding in the 5 years prior to the submission deadline may submit to Track 1.
requirements.source_quote: Only institutions without active S-STEM or STEP funding in the 5 years prior to the submission deadline may submit to Track 1.

requirements.text: The entire institution is ineligible for Track 1 if any program, department, or school within it has had an active STEP or S-STEM award in the past 5 years.
requirements.source_quote: The entire institution is ineligible if any program, department, or school within the institution has had an active STEP or S-STEM award in the past 5 years.

requirements.text: S-STEM scholarship recipients must be citizens of the United States, nationals of the United States, aliens admitted as refugees, or aliens lawfully admitted for permanent residence.
requirements.source_quote: * Be citizens of the United States, nationals of the United States (as defined in section 101(a) of the Immigration and Nationality Act), aliens admitted as refugees under section 207 of the Immigration and Nationality Act, or aliens lawfully admitted to the United States for permanent residence.

requirements.text: Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) individuals are ineligible unless they meet the criteria for citizenship/nationality/refugee/permanent residence by the time of application.
requirements.source_quote: Please note that Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) individuals are ineligible for support from this solicitation unless they meet the requirements listed in the first sentence of this bullet by the time of application for scholarship support;

requirements.text: Scholarship recipients must be enrolled at least half-time in a program leading to an associate, baccalaureate, or graduate S-STEM eligible degree.
requirements.source_quote: * Be enrolled at least half-time as defined by the institution in a program leading to an associate, baccalaureate, or graduate S-STEM eligible degree in an S-STEM eligible discipline;

requirements.text: Scholarship recipients must demonstrate academic ability or potential as defined by the institution.
requirements.source_quote: * Demonstrate academic ability or potential as defined by the institution;

requirements.text: Scholarship recipients must be low-income, following institutional guidelines based on DOE Pell/TRIO or HUD public housing programs.
requirements.source_quote: * Be low-income. The definition of low-income must follow the institutional guidelines for income thresholds that qualify the student as low-income (for example, see eligibility requirements for the U.S. Department of Education (DOE) Pell [<https://studentaid.gov/understand-aid/types/grants/pell>] and TRIO grant [<https://www.ed.gov/about/ed-offices/ope/trio/federal-trio-programs-current-year-low-income-levels>] programs or for the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) public housing program [<https://www.hud.gov/topics/rental_assistance/phprog>].

requirements.text: The institution's definition of low-income must be included in supplementary documents within the letter from the Financial Aid Office.
requirements.source_quote: The institution's definition of low-income must be included in supplementary documents within the letter from the Financial Aid Office.

requirements.text: For graduate students, demonstrated financial need is defined as financial eligibility for Graduate Assistance in Areas of National Need (GAANN).
requirements.source_quote: or, for graduate students, it is defined as financial eligibility for Graduate Assistance in Areas of National Need (GAANN).

requirements.text: Institutions must follow calculations in section II.B including other grants, fellowships, and scholarships but not loans.
requirements.source_quote: In the case of S-STEM, institutions are required to follow the calculations in section II.B that include other grants, fellowships, and scholarships but not loans.

requirements.text: Income from potential work study should not be included in the calculation for undergraduate students.
requirements.source_quote: Income from potential work study should not be included in the calculation for undergraduate students.

requirements.text: For graduate students, payment for work associated with their own research can be included in financial need calculations.
requirements.source_quote: In the case of graduate students, payment for work associated with their own research can be included.

requirements.text: Loans should not be included in calculations of unmet need for either undergraduate or graduate students.
requirements.source_quote: Loans should not be included in calculations of unmet need for either undergraduate or graduate students.

requirements.text: Collaborative proposals submitted as separate submissions from multiple organizations must be submitted via Research.gov.
requirements.source_quote: All collaborative proposals submitted as separate submissions from multiple organizations must be submitted via Research.gov.

requirements.text: Proposals requesting a six-year duration must be submitted via Research.gov because Grants.gov will not accommodate a six-year budget.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals requesting a six-year duration must be submitted via Research.gov because Grants.gov will not accommodate a six-year budget.

requirements.text: The project title must start with the acronyms 'S-STEM' followed by a colon and the complete project title.
requirements.source_quote: Please start the title with the acronyms "S-STEM" followed by ":" and the complete project title.

requirements.text: The Project Summary must explicitly address both Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts in separate statements.
requirements.source_quote: The project summary MUST explicitly address both Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts in separate statements.

requirements.text: The Project Summary must include specific details for Tracks 1, 2, and 3: number of scholarships, number of unique scholarship recipients, disciplinary areas served, objectives, expected retention/transfer/graduation rates, and basic information about student outreach, selection, support, and career services.
requirements.source_quote: For Tracks 1, 2 and 3, also include the number of scholarships to be provided, the number of unique scholarship recipients, the disciplinary areas to be served by the scholarship funds, the objectives of the project, the expected retention or transfer and graduation rates, and basic information about student outreach, application processes, selection, support, and career counseling and placement services to be provided as part of this S-STEM project.

requirements.text: The Project Description must include a section labeled 'Broader Impacts'.
requirements.source_quote: the requirement for a separate section labeled "Broader Impacts."

requirements.text: The Project Description must analyze local needs and describe interventions targeting cognitive or non-cognitive aspects of low-income students' success.
requirements.source_quote: Based on a needs assessment, proposers should focus on implementing appropriate interventions that target cognitive or non-cognitive aspects of their low-income students' experiences and success

requirements.text: Proposals must disclose the institution's definition of low-income status.
requirements.source_quote: The institution's definition of low-income must be included in the proposal and in the letter from the Financial Aid Office or equivalent submitted in supplementary documents.

requirements.text: Proposals must define academic ability, talent, or potential in a way that allows for equitable consideration of all students.
requirements.source_quote: Academic ability, talent, or potential must be defined by the institution in a way that allows for equitable consideration of all students.

requirements.text: Proposals must include a literature review establishing the rationale for new evidence-based activities.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals must include a literature review that establishes the rationale for new proposed evidence-based activities to be implemented with the proposed S-STEM funds.

requirements.text: All Tracks 1, 2, and 3 proposals must include detailed plans to provide scholars with STEM faculty mentors and placement in student cohorts.
requirements.source_quote: All Track 1, 2 and 3 proposals must include detailed plans to provide scholars with STEM faculty mentors and placement in student cohorts

requirements.text: Proposals should include adequate justification that any suggested courses or activities will not increase scholars' time to degree completion.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals should include adequate justification that any suggested courses, seminars, or other activities will not increase scholars' time to degree completion.

requirements.text: Track 3 proposals must have a research plan led by faculty in social sciences or educational research, distinct from the external evaluator.
requirements.source_quote: This research is led by PIs, Co-PIs, or senior staff who are faculty in social sciences or educational research. The faculty involved in the research component of Track 3 proposals cannot act as external evaluators for the project or work.

requirements.text: All proposals must include robust dissemination plans.
requirements.source_quote: All Track 1, 2 and 3 proposals should include robust dissemination plans to share the project's implementation mechanisms, Scholar outcomes, and/or other findings with communities that are similarly engaged in efforts to improve outcomes for low-income STEM students.

requirements.text: Proposals that do not address both Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts in the Project Summary will be returned without review.
requirements.source_quote: NSF will return without review proposals that do not address both criteria in the Project Summary.

requirements.text: Track 3 research questions must be grounded in education or social science research literature.
requirements.source_quote: Research questions must be grounded in the education or social science research literature but should also be informed by and linked to the specific needs of the student population being served at the different institutions in the consortia.

requirements.text: Scholarships may be requested for up to $15,000 per undergraduate student per year or $20,000 per graduate student per year.
requirements.source_quote: Scholarships may be requested for up to $15,000 per undergraduate student per year or $20,000 per graduate student per year.

requirements.text: For Track 1, at least 50% of the total requested amount must go to pure scholarships.
requirements.source_quote: For Track 1 projects, at least 50% of the total requested amount must go to pure scholarships to cover the cost of attendance of academically talented, domestic low-income students with demonstrated financial need.

requirements.text: Scholarship supports cannot exceed the maximum stipend amount per year of allowable funds per student.
requirements.source_quote: These scholarship supports cannot exceed the maximum stipend amount per year of allowable funds per student ($15,000 for undergraduate students and $20,000 for graduate students).

requirements.text: The proposal must explain how the number of scholarships requested and the average total scholarship amount were determined.
requirements.source_quote: Because many students may not be eligible for the maximum scholarship amounts, the proposal should explain how the number of scholarships requested and the average total scholarship amount requested were determined.

requirements.text: Funds for PI attendance at periodic S-STEM PI Conferences must be included in the budget.
requirements.source_quote: For Tracks 1, 2, and 3, funds should also be included for the PI or another member of the leadership team to attend periodic S-STEM PI Conferences.

requirements.text: Track 1 proposals must include funds for PI professional development hosted by the S-STEM REC in Year 1.
requirements.source_quote: For Track 1 proposals, in addition to the above, funds for the PI to participate in new PI professional development hosted by the S-STEM REC should be included in Year 1 of the budget.

requirements.text: Proposals must include a logic model or theory of change.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals must include a logic model or theory of change that informs the project's evaluation plan.

requirements.text: Proposals must include biographical sketches of all key collaborators not included as senior/key personnel (e.g., external evaluator).
requirements.source_quote: Proposals must include the biographical sketches in NSF format of all key collaborators not included as senior/key personnel, such as the external evaluator, advisory board members, or other consultants engaged with the project.

requirements.text: Proposals must include a table regarding the pool of potential scholars and current retention/graduation rates for eligible disciplines.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals must include the following table (or similar) regarding the pool of potential scholars and current 1-year retention rates and graduation rates for the same pool of students in each S-STEM eligible discipline that is included in the proposal.

requirements.text: Proposals must include a letter from the Financial Aid Office outlining commitments and information.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals must include a letter from the Financial Aid Office or equivalent that includes the commitments and information outlined in Section II.B.

requirements.text: Proposals must include a single PDF titled 'Project Details' in tabular form with specific scholar data.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals must include the following information in a single document PDF entitled "Project Details" in tabular form.

requirements.text: The biographical sketch of the external evaluator and their evaluation experience must be included in supplementary documents.
requirements.source_quote: A biographical sketch with the qualifications and evaluation experience of the external evaluator should also be included in supplementary documents.

requirements.text: Proposals including supplementary documents beyond those specified will be returned without review.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals that include supplementary documents beyond those specified in the PAPPG and in this solicitation may be returned without review.

requirements.text: Current and Pending Support should be reported for the first five years for six-year proposals.
requirements.source_quote: For proposals with a duration of six years, Current and Pending (Other) Support should be reported for the first five years of the project.

requirements.text: Proposers are strictly forbidden from including voluntary committed cost sharing in their budget submissions.
requirements.source_quote: Inclusion of voluntary committed cost sharing is prohibited.

requirements.text: Full proposals must be submitted by the specified deadline.
requirements.source_quote: March 04, 2025

requirements.text: For subsequent years, the proposal is due on the first Tuesday of March.
requirements.source_quote: First Tuesday in March, Annually Thereafter

requirements.text: Organizations must register with Grants.gov to create an institutional profile before using it for the first time.
requirements.source_quote: Before using Grants.gov for the first time, each organization must register to create an institutional profile.

requirements.text: The Authorized Organizational Representative (AOR) must submit the application to Grants.gov, verify the desired funding opportunity and agency, sign, and submit the application.
requirements.source_quote: the Authorized Organizational Representative (AOR) must submit the application to Grants.gov and verify the desired funding opportunity and agency to which the application is submitted. The AOR must then sign and submit the application to Grants.gov.

requirements.text: Proposers submitting via Research.gov may use that platform to verify submission status.
requirements.source_quote: Proposers that submitted via Research.gov may use Research.gov to verify the status of their submission to NSF.

requirements.text: Until an application is received and validated by NSF, the AOR must check the application status on Grants.gov.
requirements.source_quote: For proposers that submitted via Grants.gov, until an application has been received and validated by NSF, the Authorized Organizational Representative may check the status of an application on Grants.gov.

requirements.text: After receiving an email notification from NSF, proposers must use Research.gov to check the application status.
requirements.source_quote: After proposers have received an e-mail notification from NSF, Research.gov should be used to check the status of an application.

requirements.text: Proposals must include clearly stated goals, specific descriptions of intended activities, and a plan to document outputs.
requirements.source_quote: individual projects should include clearly stated goals, specific descriptions of the activities that the PI intends to do, and a plan in place to document the outputs of those activities.
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: Broader impacts activities must be well justified, even if based on innovative methods.
requirements.source_quote: The project activities may be based on previously established and/or innovative methods and approaches, but in either case must be well justified.
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: Proposals should explain what is proposed, why, how it will be done, how success will be measured, and potential benefits.
requirements.source_quote: When evaluating NSF proposals, reviewers will be asked to consider what the proposers want to do, why they want to do it, how they plan to do it, how they will know if they succeed, and what benefits could accrue if the project is successful.
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: The proposal must show that activities suggest and explore creative, original, or potentially transformative concepts.
requirements.source_quote: To what extent do the proposed activities suggest and explore creative, original, or potentially transformative concepts?
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: The plan for carrying out activities must be well-reasoned, well-organized, based on sound rationale, and incorporate a mechanism to assess success.
requirements.source_quote: Is the plan for carrying out the proposed activities well-reasoned, well-organized, and based on a sound rationale? Does the plan incorporate a mechanism to assess success?
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: The proposal must demonstrate that the individual, team, or organization is well qualified to conduct the proposed activities.
requirements.source_quote: How well qualified is the individual, team, or organization to conduct the proposed activities?
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: The proposal must demonstrate that adequate resources are available to the PI to carry out the proposed activities.
requirements.source_quote: Are there adequate resources available to the PI (either at the home organization or through collaborations) to carry out the proposed activities?
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: Reviewers will review the Data Management and Sharing Plan as appropriate.
requirements.source_quote: Proposers are reminded that reviewers will also be asked to review the Data Management and Sharing Plan and the Mentoring Plan, as appropriate.
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: Reviewers will review the Mentoring Plan as appropriate.
requirements.source_quote: Proposers are reminded that reviewers will also be asked to review the Data Management and Sharing Plan and the Mentoring Plan, as appropriate.
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: Proposals must make a case about the regional or national need for professionals with degrees awarded in this project.
requirements.source_quote: The case made about the regional or national need for professionals with degrees being awarded in this project.
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: Proposals must provide information about the likelihood of low-income scholars finding a rewarding job in the STEM workforce upon graduation.
requirements.source_quote: The information provided about the likelihood of low-income scholars to find a rewarding job in the STEM workforce upon graduation with either an undergraduate or graduate degree.
requirements.source_heading: A. Merit Review Principles and Criteria

requirements.text: No funding for infrastructure projects under an award may be obligated unless all iron, steel, manufactured products, and construction materials used in the project are produced in the United States.
requirements.source_quote: no funding made available through this funding opportunity may be obligated for infrastructure projects under an award unless all iron, steel, manufactured products, and construction materials used in the project are produced in the United States.

requirements.text: Multi-year grant Principal Investigators must submit an annual project report to the Program Officer no later than 90 days before the end of the current budget period.
requirements.source_quote: For all multi-year grants (including both standard and continuing grants), the Principal Investigator must submit an annual project report to the cognizant Program Officer no later than 90 days prior to the end of the current budget period.

requirements.text: Principal Investigators must submit a final annual project report and a project outcomes report for the general public no later than 120 days after the grant expires.
requirements.source_quote: No later than 120 days following expiration of a grant, the PI also is required to submit a final annual project report, and a project outcomes report for the general public.

requirements.text: Annual and final annual project reports must be prepared and submitted using NSF's electronic system on Research.gov.
requirements.source_quote: PIs are required to use NSF's electronic project-reporting system, available through Research.gov, for preparation and submission of annual and final annual project reports.

requirements.text: The project outcomes report must be prepared and submitted using Research.gov.
requirements.source_quote: The project outcomes report also must be prepared and submitted using Research.gov.

requirements.text: S-STEM Track 1, 2, and 3 Principal Investigators must complete information for each S-STEM Scholar on the S-STEM Monitoring system within 30 days of the start of each semester or quarter.
requirements.source_quote: Each Track 1, Track 2 and Track 3 S-STEM PI is required to complete information about each S-STEM Scholar and subsequently update the information reported through the website during each semester of continued S-STEM support. Instructions will be provided shortly after the award to successful grantees. This information must be provided within 30 days of the beginning of each semester or quarter).

requirements.text: S-STEM projects are required to collaborate with the S-STEM Resource and Evaluation Center (S-STEM-REC) initiatives.
requirements.source_quote: Projects are required to collaborate with the S-STEM-REC initiatives to showcase the impact of S-STEM funding.

requirements.text: S-STEM projects are required to cooperate and participate in a third-party independent evaluation of the program.
requirements.source_quote: Projects are required to cooperate and participate in a third-party independent evaluation of the S-STEM program.

cap_usd.quote: Awards for Track 2 (Implementation Projects) projects may not exceed $2,000,000 total for a maximum duration of 6 years.

max_years.quote: Awards for Track 2 (Implementation Projects) projects may not exceed $2,000,000 total for a maximum duration of 6 years.

cost_share.quote: Inclusion of voluntary committed cost sharing is prohibited.

min_participant_support_pct.quote: "In all Track 2 proposals, at least 60% of all funds must be provided solely as pure scholarships to cover the cost of attendance and entered as Participant Support – Stipends (Line F1)"

max_participant_support_per_person_usd.quote: The established maximum amount of an individual scholarship is $15,000 per year for undergraduate students

subaward_mtdc_limit_usd.quote: 2 CFR 200.1: MTDC includes "up to the first $50,000 of each subaward".

external_evaluator.quote: "Each Track 1, 2, and 3 proposal should describe a rigorous, clear and specific external evaluation plan ... executed by an external evaluator"
